Work out what makes the format successful—especially the opening delivery, how the presenter and supporting footage alternate, how captions stay readable without covering the face, and how the ending turns the story into one clear action. Before making anything, ask me what I actually want to say, who the video is for, what context the viewer needs, and what I want them to do at the end. This format may need me or another approved person on camera and may benefit from a usable voice clone. If you do not already have the right footage, clean voice recordings, or permission to use that person's likeness and voice, ask me to provide them and complete the normal consent step. Also ask for any product footage, screenshots, logos, proof, music direction, brand information, or CTA details that would make the story specific and credible.

Once you understand the message and have the necessary inputs, show me the proposed script and production plan, explain which references informed which creative choices, and give me the expected spend before starting paid generation.
